# Description

Summarize the change and the motivation for it. Link the issue it closes, and note any
dependency or configuration change it requires.

Fixes #(issue)

## Checklist

- [ ] Changes are limited to a single goal (no scope creep).
- [ ] I have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and followed it.
- [ ] `pnpm lint:check` and `pnpm format:check` pass.
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm build` pass.
- [ ] `pnpm test:coverage` passes and stays above the 95% threshold.
- [ ] `pnpm knip` reports no new dead code or unused dependencies.
- [ ] Documentation is updated if behavior, configuration, or telemetry changed.
- [ ] I wrote this contribution, or otherwise have the right to submit it under the
      project's [MIT license](../LICENSE).
